mu.rule: mean AdjO over all FBS teams (= mean FBS AdjD); includes tentative teams below the game minimum

phantom_game.rule: mean AdjO / AdjD of the division's teams (the teams list above)

home_field.rule: estimated by the unshrunk fit (prior 0) and held fixed; ratings.rate() reproduces it

muT.rule: mean possessions per team per game over these games

network.rule: NS_win = mean opponent_NS where team_won = 1; NS_loss = mean where 0; NS_all = mean of all rows
